text:
lee (sales): Quick heads up — MedInsure sent their vendor risk pack and want IAM proofs. They specifically called out: SAML IdP metadata, evidence MFA is enforced for admin console, RBAC exports showing role least-privilege, and a short writeup on how we handle service accounts. Can we deliver by Friday?

maya (solutions): Yes. I'll bundle IdP+SP metadata, screenshots of console policy toggles, export roles JSON, and make a 5-step SSO validation checklist.

beth@medinsure: Also: can you provide a sample of the authentication logs (last 60 days) showing MFA success/failure counts? Pseudonymized users are OK.

owen (security): We'll provide aggregated counts plus sample lines with pseudonymized IDs. We also enforce MFA via policy on interactive sign-ins (admin console). Service accounts use STS short-lived tokens (24h max) and are logged.

lee (sales): Legal question: will you include plaintext emails or obfuscated IDs?

owen (security): Default is obfuscated ids (user-###) and redacted IPs. Full details only with signed NDA or customer-signed log addendum.

maya (solutions): Example role extract we'll include:

```json
[{"role":"owner","permissions":["*"]},{"role":"ops","permissions":["deploy","alerts:ack"]},{"role":"analyst","permissions":["usage:view"]}]
```

artifact-bot: uploaded medinsure-iam-packet-1827003333.tar.gz -> https://secure-share.company/MedInsure/1827003333 (internal)

beth@medinsure: Thanks — can you also map each artifact to the SIG question numbers? Our risk team wants the mapping to speed review.

owen (security): Will provide mapping doc: e.g., CCM_AAC_01 -> SSO enabled (artifact: idp-metadata.xml), CCM_AAC_02 -> MFA enforced (artifact: mfa-policy.pdf + logs), CCM_AAC_03 -> RBAC (roles.json + screenshots).

lee (sales): Plan: Maya/Owen to finalize packet Thurs EOD; I'll send preliminary packet Fri AM without usernames. Update here if legal asks for more. :white_check_mark:
